# `redundant-comptime`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports an explicit `comptime` expression already inside a comptime scope.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The keyword adds no evaluation guarantee and makes the actual comptime boundary
harder to see.

## When it fires

It applies to nested expressions where the enclosing block already requires
compile-time evaluation.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f() void {
    comptime {
        const n = comptime 1 + 2;
        _ = n;
    }
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#comptime>
